about.en: DarkSwap (DARK) is the token of DarkSwap, a privacy-focused swap interface for Solana-origin transfers. It prepares orders and quotes that the user funds from their own wallet, routing them through HoudiniSwap or the NEAR Intents 1Click API, so the service never connects a wallet, signs the deposit or custodies funds. DARK is a Token-2022 mint on Solana at 7KEPApdbBMByrmqihz3bht2uMhFQcatjfSFQCKq66kH3; the project directs half of the creator fees it receives to qualifying holders in wNEAR and uses the rest to buy ZEC for its treasury.
